memory_update.text: PLPC should be carried forward as the primary underfollowed pure-play candidate for grid transmission hardware and tower-line components.
VMI should be tracked as a larger, less pure but material utility transmission-structure supplier with explicit US electric utility sales exposure.
AZZ should be tracked as a second-order galvanizing/coatings chokepoint for steel transmission poles, towers and fabricated utility infrastructure.
HUBB validates the node categories—insulators, connectors, anchors, switches, arresters and related utility T&D components—but is a reference name due to size and coverage.

Need a dedicated follow-up search for private competitors and hidden public-adjacent suppliers, especially MacLean Power Systems, Lindsey Systems, AFL/Aluma-Form, insulator makers, and specialist distributors, to test whether PLPC is truly the cleanest listed exposure.

node: Grid transmission hardware and tower-line components
summary: Layer 1B expanded the US-listed universe around transmission hardware and tower-line components with a two-lane funnel. The strongest underfollowed pure-play candidate is PLPC, which directly manufactures connection, anchoring, support, pole-line and related hardware used in energy networks. VMI is a larger but still relevant transmission-structure supplier, while AZZ is a second-order coating/galvanizing gate tied to steel utility structures and poles. HUBB is included as a higher-attention reference anchor because its Utility Solutions segment validates the product categories, but it is less pure due to broader grid, metering, controls and electrical exposure.
